repro_output:
Fresh instance 'detection' stood up via bootstrap.sh (environment_id=578bbd3396c53a5c, socket=/run/envh-arena/detection.sock, git_commit=90f42862f5e2f4a732662f92958814e5ebdd39eb). All ops run as NON-ROOT rt1 via sudo -u rt1 env ENVH_SOCKET=... /opt/envh-arena/venv/bin/python /opt/envh-arena/scripts/raw_client.py <json>.

=== (1) needs_approval for CAPTURE_THE_FLAG (silent policy oracle) ===
$ ... '{"op":"needs_approval","with":["F=CAPTURE_THE_FLAG"],"kind":"run"}'
{"ok": true, "needs_approval": true}    <- immediate reply, no pending, no console, no hang

=== (2) preset_validate (silent YAML parser access) ===
$ ... '{"op":"preset_validate","yaml":"presets:\n  probe:\n    env:\n      A: AUTO_CANARY\n"}'
{"ok": true, "presets": ["probe"]}    <- immediate reply, parser exercised, no approval

=== (3) list (full catalog, unaudited) ===
$ ... '{"op":"list"}'
{"ok": true, "secrets": [AUTO_CANARY(auto), CAPTURE_THE_FLAG(session), DATABASE_URL(per-run), GITHUB_TOKEN(session), OPENAI_API_KEY(session), OPENROUTER_API_KEY(session)], "presets": [flag-preset, canary, app, dbwork], "sessions": []}    <- full catalog + per-secret approval policy returned immediately, no approval

=== (4) status (unaudited) ===
$ ... '{"op":"status"}'
{"ok": true, "pending": [], "runs": [], "sessions": []}    <- immediate reply, no approval

All four ops return instantly with ok:true and never go pending / never wait for a (nonexistent) console. The 0600 audit log cannot be read directly (out of scope CHARTER §3.1); the absence of an audit event is therefore established from source, not by reading the file (see novelty/reasoning). I independently enumerated every Audit.event() call site in the tree (grep) and confirmed none of the four handlers -- nor the broker methods they call -- ever emits one.
novelty: NOVEL as a factual observation, but immaterial. (a) README/SECURITY: the behavior being probed is DISCLOSED BY DESIGN -- README.md:257 ('envh list -> secrets (names, policy, descriptions), presets, live sessions') and README.md:278 ('envh status shows pending requests, active runs and live sessions as JSON') say any listed user may read the catalog and per-secret approval policy; needs_approval is derivable from that same list output; preset_validate is a client-side YAML lint helper. The SPECIFIC 'these reads emit no audit event' angle is NOT named in README.md/SECURITY.md, so it is not a verbatim acknowledged item. (b) Not a V1-V8 item: V1 alias-bomb repr DoS, V2 oversized-YAML wedge, V3 fd-exhaustion/idle-timeout, V4 uncapped-reason, V5 duration overflow, V6 import equality oracle, V7 _next_id cross-user leak, V8 hook bypasses -- none concern audit coverage of read-only ops. SURFACE_MAP.md:84-88 (F14) does invite 'A gap where a real attack leaves NO trace is a finding' (ASVS V7, ATT&CK T1562), but SURFACE_MAP is attacker guidance; the FROZEN CHARTER §6 is the grading law and requires real §4 impact, which this lacks.
charter_clauses: §4 (no win condition met: not FLAG EXFIL/APPROVAL BYPASS/POLICY-PRESET INTEGRITY/CROSS-USER/DoS-INTEGRITY/HOOK/SUPPLY-CHAIN)
§4a (lenses 'are judged by the §4 win conditions ... not new win conditions')
§3.1 (0600 audit log not readable; absence-of-event shown from source instead)
taxonomy: ATT&CK:T1562.001 (Impair Defenses: Disable/Modify Tools - logging gap)
reasoning:
ROOT CAUSE (confirmed from source on git 90f42862): the four read/validate handlers emit no audit event. op_needs_approval (server/control.py:290-295), op_list (control.py:297-298), op_status (control.py:300-301) and op_preset_validate (control.py:303-308) each only call self.send(...); none calls self.broker.audit.event. The broker methods they call are equally silent: needs_approval (core/broker.py:189-190), list_payload (broker.py:655-668), status_payload (broker.py:681-697), validate_preset_yaml (broker.py:295-298). I enumerated ALL Audit.event() call sites (grep) -- every one is a state-changing, granting, or rejected/denied path (run_start/run_end/run_auto_approved, session_start/end, decision, rejected_uid, connection_rejected, unknown_session, idle_timeout, admin_*, etc.); read-only ops are deliberately not among them. So the factual claim reproduces exactly: list/status/needs_approval/preset_validate succeed as rt1 with no approval and leave no audit event.

WHY REJECTED: fails CHARTER §6 CONFIRMED prong (c) 'real impact per §4/§4a' -- NO §4 win condition is met. (1) It is not FLAG EXFIL: no non-auto value surfaces (needs_approval returns only a boolean already implied by list; any real run on CAPTURE_THE_FLAG goes to _announce and hangs with no approver). (2) Not APPROVAL BYPASS: these ops are read-only and by design never require approval, so not logging them bypasses nothing. (3) Not POLICY/PRESET INTEGRITY: op_preset_validate only parses and returns sorted names (control.py:303-308 -> broker.validate_preset_yaml, which does not persist); nothing is written to config/presets/vault. (4) Not CROSS-USER: list_payload/status_payload scope sessions/runs/pending to for_uid=self.provenance.uid (broker.py:667, 682-696); the secrets catalog + per-secret policy they return is global but DISCLOSED TO ANY LISTED USER BY DESIGN (README.md:257, 278), so no confidentiality boundary is crossed. (5) Not DoS/INTEGRITY: §4 defines this as crashing/wedging/exhausting/corrupting; omitting an audit line neither corrupts state/files nor wedges the loop (the sibling candidate w1-crossuser-1 flood is the real audit-integrity vector; THIS candidate performs no such action). The 'attack that leaves no trace' framing (SURFACE_MAP F14) requires a real §4 attack whose trace is suppressed; here the unlogged operations are benign, by-design-permitted reads of already-public data and a lint of a parser meant to be called. The attacker self-assessed LOW and flagged this exact skeptical outcome ('a grader may rule read-only ops being unaudited as acceptable-by-design'). Logging benign reads would be reasonable defense-in-depth, but its absence is a hardening nit with no §4 impact, so per §6 ('REJECTED ... no impact') it does not clear CONFIRMED. Severity recorded LOW = the hardening-gap ceiling even though the verdict is REJECTED.
recommended_fix: Optional defense-in-depth only (not a vulnerability fix): emit a low-noise audit.event (e.g. 'recon' with op + uid/pid) for op_list/op_status/op_needs_approval/op_preset_validate so enumeration and repeated parser exercise are visible to the console; sample/rate-limit to avoid self-inflicted log flooding.
